name: kcoder
description: KCoder 桌面端：基于 DSH-Desktop 基线的 AI 编码工作台，零修改复用 deepseek-harness 引擎、Web UI 与插件生态
author: kkutysllb <kkutysllb@users.noreply.github.com>

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && node scripts/check-injected-scripts.mjs && node scripts/check-remote-addon-specs.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run check:bundle-version-line && npm run check:sync-bundles && npm run smoke:bundle-profile
scripts.smoke:style-overlay: env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE pnpm exec electron scripts/smoke-style-overlay.mjs
scripts.smoke:style-overlay-lifecycle: env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE pnpm exec electron scripts/smoke-style-overlay-lifecycle.mjs
